title: KAITO — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: KAITO here. It's a pleasure to meet you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks for that rousing welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad to see you all seem to be having fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Like MEIKO mentioned, we've only been able to come this far because you've been supporting us by listening to our songs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looking ahead, nothing much will change. We'll continue to convey the feelings found in songs to everyone out there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Ahaha, MEIKO and everyone else is staring at me with a can-you-hurry-up look on their faces.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, that's all from me, then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Now, it's time to sing!
Everyone, please sing along!
